title: People one sick person infects in an unprotected crowd (R0)

source.name: The basic reproduction number (R0) of measles: a systematic review (Guerra et al., The Lancet Infectious Diseases, 2017) and published R0 reviews for the comparison diseases
source.publisher: The Lancet Infectious Diseases / peer-reviewed R0 literature, as summarised by the U.S. CDC and WHO

notes: Values are midpoints of the published ranges: measles 12-18 (plotted 15), chickenpox 10-12 (plotted 11), polio 5-7 (plotted 6), seasonal influenza mean R0 about 1.33 (plotted 1.3). CDC states the same thing in plain terms: if one person has measles, up to 9 out of 10 unprotected people close to them will catch it.
